## Supplementary Figures

::: {#suppfig-pollen-coverage}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-02-pollen-coverage.png){width=90% fig-alt="Pollen-record coverage."}

**Pollen-record coverage.** The `pollen_coverage` profile describes the `r format(preparation_pool_n, big.mark = ",")`-record preparation pool before analysis-specific predictor and control eligibility. Missing locations or intervals denote unavailable records, not absence of pollen-producing vegetation; negative values are not applicable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-human-coverage}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-03-human-coverage.png){width=90% fig-alt="Human-proxy coverage."}

**Human-proxy coverage.** The `human_coverage` profile shows SPD availability around the preparation pool under the 250 km neighbourhood with 500 km fallback. Missing coverage denotes insufficient dated evidence, not absence of people; negative values are not applicable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-event-coverage}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-04-event-coverage.png){width=90% fig-alt="Regional pollen-event coverage."}

**Regional pollen-event coverage.** The `event_coverage` profile distinguishes observed expert-screened chronologies from default-filled records in the preparation pool. An undetected or missing event does not imply human absence; negative values are not applicable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-model-fit}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-22-hvarpart-profiles.png){width=90% fig-alt="HVarPart extraction-profile comparison."}

**HVarPart extraction-profile comparison.** The `hvarpart_diagnostics` profile compares signed, zero-truncated, and exclude-negative allocations for each analysis-specific available cohort. Negative signed components retain suppressor/commonality meaning; missing decompositions are unavailable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-signed-results}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-25-h1-spatial-signed.png){width=90% fig-alt="Signed controlled spatial H1 contributions."}

**Signed controlled spatial H1 counterpart.** The `spd_spatiotemporal_balance` cohort and time/space controls match Fig. 2. Negative values are signed human-minus-climate contribution differences, not negative explained variance; missing records are non-estimable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-dependence-controls}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-31-moran.png){width=90% fig-alt="Residual Moran diagnostic."}

**Residual Moran diagnostic.** The `spd_spatiotemporal_balance` profile tests spatial dependence before and after controls in the eligible spatial cohort. Positive or negative Moran values indicate clustering direction; missing tests are non-estimable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-predictor-trajectories}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-16-predictor-spd.png){width=90% fig-alt="SPD temporal trajectories."}

**SPD temporal trajectories.** The `predictor_temporal` profile shows observed and HGAM-smoothed archaeological SPD within 8.5–2.0 ka BP regional and climate-zone coverage. Missing segments indicate insufficient dates, not human absence; negative centred values are relative model-scale deviations.
:::

::: {#suppfig-spd-radius}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-35-spd-radius-spatial.png){width=90% fig-alt="Spatial SPD-radius comparison."}

**Spatial SPD-radius sensitivity.** The `spd_radius` profile compares strict 250 and 500 km predictors in `r format(radius_spatial_n, big.mark = ",")` matched records, with `r format(radius_spatial_defined_n, big.mark = ",")` defined zero-truncated pairs. Negative balances indicate greater climate allocation; missing pairs are not assigned zero.
:::

::: {#suppfig-event-sensitivity}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-38-event-spatial.png){width=90% fig-alt="Spatial event inclusion sensitivity."}

**Spatial human-event sensitivity.** The `human_event_inclusion` profile compares SPD-only, event-only, and combined predictors in `r event_spatial_n` matched observed-event records. Negative balances indicate greater climate allocation; missing zero-truncated balances are retained as missing.
:::

::: {#suppfig-h2}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-01-h2-interrelationships.png){width=90% fig-alt="PAP ordination trajectories and zero-truncated human and climate allocations by region and climate zone."}

**H2 PAP-interrelationship result.** Rows represent North America, Central and South America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania, and columns represent eligible fixed modern Köppen-Geiger climate zones. Within each panel, grey circles show the distribution of pairwise Procrustes sum-of-squares distances among 500-year time slices, and the blue trajectory shows sample scores from the distance-based redundancy analysis from 8.5 ka BP (dark blue) towards 2.0 ka BP (light blue). Gold and teal arrows show the direction and relative strength of associations with human SPD and palaeoclimate, respectively. The adjacent bars show the zero-truncated human-climate composition for changes in relationships among all ten PAPs; negative signed contributions were set to zero before rescaling. Missing panels are non-estimable rather than evidence of stable PAP relationships or no driver effect. Signed contributions are shown in @suppfig-h2-signed.
:::

::: {#suppfig-record-examples}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-05-record-examples.png){width=90% fig-alt="Two updated pollen-record examples."}

**Updated record examples.** The `predictor_temporal` profile shows record-level PAP and predictor inputs for two illustrative records, without spatial aggregation. Negative signed HVarPart components retain suppressor/commonality meaning; missing values are unavailable, and examples are not representative cohort summaries.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-n0}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-06-pap-n0.png){width=90% fig-alt="N0 PAP trajectory."}

**$N_0$ trajectory.** Equal-weighted `pap_temporal` posterior averages describe taxonomic richness over observed record coverage from 8.5 to 2.0 ka BP. Missing segments are unavailable; negative transformed predictions are model-scale quantities, not negative taxon counts.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-n1}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-07-pap-n1.png){width=90% fig-alt="N1 PAP trajectory."}

**$N_1$ trajectory.** Equal-weighted `pap_temporal` posterior averages describe Shannon-effective diversity over observed record coverage from 8.5 to 2.0 ka BP. Missing segments are unavailable; negative transformed predictions are model-scale quantities.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-n2}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-08-pap-n2.png){width=90% fig-alt="N2 PAP trajectory."}

**$N_2$ trajectory.** Equal-weighted `pap_temporal` posterior averages describe Simpson-effective diversity over observed record coverage from 8.5 to 2.0 ka BP. Missing segments are unavailable; negative transformed predictions are model-scale quantities.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-n1-minus-n2}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-09-pap-n1-minus-n2.png){width=90% fig-alt="N1 minus N2 PAP trajectory."}

**$N_1-N_2$ trajectory.** Equal-weighted `pap_temporal` posterior averages describe the separation of Shannon- and Simpson-effective diversity over observed coverage. Missing segments are unavailable, and signed transformed values retain their model-scale meaning.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-n2-n1}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-10-pap-n2-n1.png){width=90% fig-alt="N2 divided by N1 PAP trajectory."}

**$N_2/N_1$ trajectory.** Equal-weighted `pap_temporal` posterior averages describe dominance-sensitive evenness over observed 8.5–2.0 ka BP coverage. Missing segments are unavailable; negative transformed predictions are model-scale quantities.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-n1-n0}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-11-pap-n1-n0.png){width=90% fig-alt="N1 divided by N0 PAP trajectory."}

**$N_1/N_0$ trajectory.** Equal-weighted `pap_temporal` posterior averages describe richness-sensitive evenness over observed 8.5–2.0 ka BP coverage. Missing segments are unavailable; negative transformed predictions are model-scale quantities.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-roc}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-12-pap-roc.png){width=90% fig-alt="Rate-of-change PAP trajectory."}

**Rate-of-change trajectory.** Equal-weighted `pap_temporal` posterior averages describe pollen compositional change over observed record coverage. Missing segments are unavailable, and negative transformed predictions do not denote a negative ecological rate.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-dcca}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-13-pap-dcca.png){width=90% fig-alt="DCCA axis 1 PAP trajectory."}

**DCCA axis 1 trajectory.** Equal-weighted `pap_temporal` posterior averages describe the primary compositional gradient over observed record coverage. The axis sign is arbitrary; missing segments are unavailable rather than zero change.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-density-diversity}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-14-pap-density-diversity.png){width=90% fig-alt="Density-diversity PAP trajectory."}

**Density-diversity trajectory.** Equal-weighted `pap_temporal` posterior averages describe diversity change-point density over observed record coverage. Missing segments are unavailable, and negative transformed predictions are model-scale quantities.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-density-turnover}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-15-pap-density-turnover.png){width=90% fig-alt="Density-turnover PAP trajectory."}

**Density-turnover trajectory.** Equal-weighted `pap_temporal` posterior averages describe turnover change-point density over observed record coverage. Missing segments are unavailable, and negative transformed predictions are model-scale quantities.
:::

::: {#suppfig-temporal-signed}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-26-h1-temporal-signed.png){width=90% fig-alt="Signed controlled temporal H1 contributions."}

**Signed controlled temporal H1 counterpart.** The `time_slice_spd_spatial_control` cohort and spatial dbMEM controls match Fig. 3. Negative contributions retain suppressor/commonality meaning; missing region-age combinations are non-estimable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pollen-retention}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-28-pollen-retention.png){width=85% fig-alt="Pollen-count threshold retention diagnostic."}

**Pollen retention and bias–coverage diagnostic.** The `pollen_threshold_diagnostic` profile compares 300-, 500-, and 1,000-grain thresholds with the baseline preparation pool. This is not an H1 refit; missing strata have no retained records, and negative values are not applicable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-collinearity}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-29-pap-collinearity.png){width=90% fig-alt="PAP correlation and HVarPart influence diagnostic."}

**PAP correlation and influence diagnostic.** The `pap_collinearity` profile uses paired records from the original H1 inventory to evaluate response redundancy and contribution changes. Negative signed changes retain direction; missing pairs are excluded rather than assigned zero.
:::

::: {#suppfig-predictor-temp-annual}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-17-predictor-temp-annual.png){width=90% fig-alt="Annual temperature trajectories."}

**Annual-temperature trajectories.** The `predictor_temporal` profile uses point-extracted transient-climate values within the eligible pollen coverage. Missing segments are unavailable; negative centred values indicate relative model-scale deviations rather than invalid temperatures.
:::

::: {#suppfig-predictor-temp-cold}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-18-predictor-temp-cold.png){width=90% fig-alt="Coldest-month temperature trajectories."}

**Coldest-month temperature trajectories.** The `predictor_temporal` profile uses point-extracted transient-climate values within the eligible pollen coverage. Missing segments are unavailable; negative values retain their temperature or centred model-scale interpretation.
:::

::: {#suppfig-predictor-prec-summer}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-19-predictor-prec-summer.png){width=90% fig-alt="Summer precipitation trajectories."}

**Warm-season precipitation trajectories.** The `predictor_temporal` profile uses point-extracted transient-climate values within the eligible pollen coverage. Missing segments are unavailable; negative centred values are relative model-scale deviations.
:::

::: {#suppfig-predictor-prec-winter}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-20-predictor-prec-winter.png){width=90% fig-alt="Winter precipitation trajectories."}

**Cold-season precipitation trajectories.** The `predictor_temporal` profile uses point-extracted transient-climate values within the eligible pollen coverage. Missing segments are unavailable; negative centred values are relative model-scale deviations.
:::

::: {#suppfig-event-trajectories}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-21-event-trajectories.png){width=90% fig-alt="Regional pollen-event trajectories."}

**Regional pollen-event trajectories.** The `event_temporal` profile shows HGAM-smoothed expert-screened event evidence by region and fixed modern climate zone. Events are complementary and partly circular; missing segments are unavailable, and negative centred values are relative model-scale deviations.
:::

::: {#suppfig-pap-reduced}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-30-pap-reduced.png){width=90% fig-alt="Reduced-PAP response sensitivity."}

**Reduced-PAP response sensitivity.** The `pap_collinearity` profile compares complete and reduced PAP responses within paired H1 records. Zero-truncated displays omit negative signed components; missing pairs are non-estimable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-adjusted-r2}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-23-adjusted-r2.png){width=90% fig-alt="Adjusted R-squared distribution."}

**Adjusted $R^2$ distributions.** The `hvarpart_diagnostics` profile reports total model fit for available spatial H1 decompositions by region and climate zone. Negative adjusted $R^2$ values denote fits worse than the adjusted null benchmark; missing models are unavailable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-fit-importance}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-24-fit-importance.png){width=90% fig-alt="Model fit versus human importance."}

**Model fit versus human importance.** The `hvarpart_diagnostics` profile compares total adjusted $R^2$ with signed human hierarchical contribution in available spatial SPD models. Negative contributions retain suppressor/commonality meaning, and missing models are excluded rather than assigned zero.
:::

::: {#suppfig-h2-signed}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-27-h2-signed.png){width=90% fig-alt="Signed H2 contributions."}

**Signed H2 counterpart.** The `h2_interrelationships` cohort and region/climate-zone grouping match Fig. 4. Negative contributions retain suppressor/commonality meaning; missing panels are non-estimable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-thinning}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-32-thinning.png){width=90% fig-alt="Spatial thinning sensitivity."}

**Spatial thinning sensitivity.** The controlled SPD H1 profile is repeatedly thinned at 250 and 500 km. Negative balance values indicate greater climate allocation; missing replicate estimates are non-estimable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-leave-out}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-33-leave-out.png){width=90% fig-alt="Leave-one-group-out sensitivity."}

**Leave-one-group-out sensitivity.** The controlled SPD H1 profile omits each region or climate zone in turn from its eligible cohort. Negative balance values indicate greater climate allocation; missing exclusions lack an estimable comparison.
:::

::: {#suppfig-unique-fractions}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-34-unique-r2.png){width=90% fig-alt="Unique adjusted R-squared fractions."}

**Unique adjusted-$R^2$ fractions.** The `spd_events_spatial_control` profile isolates non-shared human, climate, and spatial contributions in eligible region-age cohorts. Fractions do not form a composition; negative values are valid adjusted estimates, and missing fractions are non-estimable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-radius-temporal}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-36-spd-radius-temporal.png){width=90% fig-alt="Temporal SPD-radius profiles."}

**Temporal SPD-radius profiles.** The spatially controlled `spd_radius` profile compares strict radii across `r radius_temporal_n` matched region-age combinations. Negative signed contributions are truncated only for this display; missing combinations are non-estimable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-radius-change}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-37-spd-radius-change.png){width=90% fig-alt="Temporal SPD-radius changes."}

**Temporal SPD-radius changes.** The spatially controlled `spd_radius` profile reports 500-minus-250 km change in zero-truncated human allocation for matched region-age combinations. Negative values shift toward climate; missing changes are non-estimable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-event-temporal}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-39-event-temporal.png){width=90% fig-alt="Temporal event inclusion profiles."}

**Temporal human-event profiles.** The spatially controlled `human_event_inclusion` profile compares the three human-predictor definitions in `r event_temporal_n` matched region-age combinations. Negative signed contributions are truncated only for display; missing combinations are non-estimable.
:::

::: {#suppfig-event-change}
![](figures/supplementary-figure-40-event-change.png){width=90% fig-alt="Temporal event inclusion changes."}

**Temporal human-event changes.** The spatially controlled `human_event_inclusion` profile reports changes from SPD-only in matched region-age combinations. Negative values shift the zero-truncated human allocation downward; missing changes are non-estimable, and event evidence is not independent validation.
:::
